parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.LLR_OPENAI_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini', response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You extract proposed operational records for Lost Limb Riders, a nonprofit. For cash_contribution items may be empty, amount_paid must be null, and amount_received must be positive. Preserve the original transcript in source_transcript. Allowed transaction_type values: donation_received, purchase_received, reimbursement_requested, inventory_used, inventory_adjustment, cash_contribution, equipment_received. Do not add other fields.
